/* Link only in RAM at FEBF8000. The initial entry remains real CodeFlash8CB1A.
 * Route its returned LP to one of these two labels. No firmware overlay,
 * replacement callback or direct8C960 continuation is used. */
    .section .text.dcm_event_dtc,"ax"
    .align 2
    .global dcm_dtc_deliver_queued_generation
 dcm_dtc_deliver_queued_generation:
    /* A new derived source generation must not replace retained local tuples. */
    mov 0xfebe602c, r1
    mov 8, r10
    st.w r10, 0[r1]
    mov 0x00098946, r1
    jarl [r1], lp
    /* Normal delivery stops at95644 before this return. */
    .global dcm_dtc_unexpected_return
 dcm_dtc_unexpected_return:
    br dcm_dtc_unexpected_return

    .global dcm_dtc_cancel_before_queue_delivery
 dcm_dtc_cancel_before_queue_delivery:
    mov 0x0009165e, r1
    jarl [r1], lp
    mov 0x00098946, r1
    jarl [r1], lp
    .global dcm_dtc_cancel_done
 dcm_dtc_cancel_done:
    br dcm_dtc_cancel_done
